verses.text: In the LORD|strong="H3068" put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as* a bird to your mountain?
For, lo, the wicked bend their* bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
The LORD|strong="H3068" is* in his holy temple, the LORD’s|strong="H3068" throne is* in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
The LORD|strong="H3068" trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be* the portion of their cup.
For the righteous LORD|strong="H3068" loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
